mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates on equity cash flows and compressing future earnings expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in HOUST (housing demand) signals increased consumer confidence and spending, boosting corporate earnings growth and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for HOUST trends fails to predict returns, or 20-day returns in HOUST up periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in HOUST (housing demand) and RSAFS (final goods demand) signals robust consumer and business spending, amplifying corporate earnings growth and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS does not statistically predict returns (p > 0.05 in t-test), or their combined signal is not stronger than individual signals.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO (supply index) reflects robust production capacity, lowering inflation expectations and compressing growth forecasts, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO's rise does not lead to negative returns in 60% of cases over 2-year windows, or Rank IC < 0.03 in supply-trend periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE (unemployment rate) signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE decline does not consistently predict positive returns (p > 0.05 in t-test), or in non-recession regimes the effect is muted.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate crosses above 4.5%, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, it raises discount rates on equity cash flows and reduces growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% but returns do not turn negative, or in non-tightening regimes the signal is ineffective (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS signals easing monetary policy, amplifying growth expectations and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In non-late-cycle regimes, FEDFUNDS easing does not predict positive returns (p > 0.05), or the regime shift is not detected in the walk-forward analysis.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST crosses above 700, signaling a surge in housing demand, it boosts construction activity and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST crosses above 700 but returns do not rise, or in non-surge periods the effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
